claims.claim: Hebrew SMS is limited to 70 characters per segment (vs 160 for Latin alphabet) because non-Latin scripts force UCS-2 encoding.

claims.claim: A UCS-2 encoded SMS is limited to 70 characters, and beyond that splits into segments of 67 characters.
claims.raw_snippet: This reduces the single message character limit from 160 to 70. If the message exceeds 70 characters, it splits the message into two or more messages with 67 characters each.
